estimator: Arithmetic mean of worker x visit medians. Primary condition estimates give independent A/B observations equal weight. One shared worker/visit hierarchical bootstrap over all eight cells; no within-visit sample resampling.
interpretation: Positive time reduction means shorter kernel event time; it is not a layout gain. All labels execute the same frozen CUBIN, Loaded function, shape, parameters and graph. Equivalence is an observed classification, not an enforced result. All difference intervals use paired replicate differences.
limitations: All measurements are unlocked. Sampled NVML clocks do not establish fixed frequency or per-kernel frequency and cannot isolate a causal DVFS effect.
NVML power/utilization readings have hardware averaging windows that may extend beyond a visit/context label; query timestamps do not make them instantaneous per-kernel measurements.

Between-sample guard, idle and preload interventions may affect several mechanisms including cache state, temperature, frequency and scheduling. Kernel timing events exclude their host/preload duration.
Three workers provide limited evidence about the platform population. Repeated within-worker observations are not independent GPU allocations.
A failed A/B sham equivalence check remains a reported result; no worker or condition is dropped to obtain a favorable outcome.
Raw-sample, visit and worker ranges/quantiles are descriptive variability measures; extreme-value ranges are not confidence intervals.

The disjoint primer has independent allocations and a different frozen CUBIN but exercises similar memory/computation resources. It can affect shared cache state as well as GPU execution state; it is not a cache-free intervention.

A recovery percentage is an unstable ratio when idle-minus-fast approaches or crosses zero. Its interval is omitted unless every bootstrap denominator is positive; no draws are discarded and no recovery outcome is required.

telemetry.mask_scope: clock_event_reasons is a sampled bitmask, not elapsed throttling time; unavailable getters retain their return codes and errors.
telemetry.scope: NVML samples grouped by worker/phase/case/condition. Context labels may span host gaps and multiple kernels; no per-kernel clock attribution, clock locking, or causal DVFS conclusion follows.

telemetry_associations.alias_window_scope: A/B are interleaved observations within the same condition/visit block; their identical telemetry windows are not independent telemetry observations.

telemetry_associations.scope: Descriptive correlations between matched visit-level time differences and NVML sample-mean differences. Only samples whose query start lies in each recorded visit window are included. Missing windows remain missing; no interpolation, per-kernel clock assignment or causal interpretation. Power/utilization hardware averaging can cross window boundaries.

wake_interpretation: The timed target is identical in all observations. Priming kernels execute outside target events. Recovery after a disjoint-buffer, different-CUBIN primer would show that reuse of the exact target data is not necessary; it does not uniquely identify frequency, clock gating, scheduling, event overhead or another GPU-state mechanism.
